title: Whale You Go Green? Immediate and Longitudinal Effects of Embodied Conversational AI Avatars on Sustainable Behavioral Tendencies and Pro-Environmental Attitudes
abstract: arXiv:2610.33191v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Embodied conversational AI can be persuasive, but can it motivate people to develop sustainable behavioral tendencies and increase pro-environmental attitudes? We conducted a randomized experiment (N = 576) comparing four embodied avatars--a beluga whale, Greta Thunberg, Emma Watson, and a generic human--with a text chatbot and no-intervention control. All embodied conditions increased immediate sustainable product selection relative to the control (beta = .401-.609, all q <= .0126) and chatbot (beta = .398-.604, all q <= .007), without differing significantly from one another. Only the Beluga condition increased immediate pro-environmental attitudes relative to the control after correction. Among 287 returners assessed two months later, following an intermediate assigned-condition session, Beluga also showed significantly higher pre-booster sustainable product choice compared to the control (beta = .657, q = .0176). translated_title: “鲸”你环保吗？具身对话式AI化身对可持续行为倾向与亲环境态度的即时及纵向影响
translated_abstract: 具身对话式AI具有说服力，但它能否促使人们形成可持续的行为倾向并增强亲环境态度？我们开展了一项随机实验（N = 576），比较了四种具身化身——白鲸、格蕾塔·通贝里、艾玛·沃特森和一个普通人类——与文本聊天机器人以及无干预对照组的效果。相对于对照组，所有具身条件均提高了即时的可持续产品选择（beta = .401-.609，所有 q <= .0126），也优于聊天机器人（beta = .398-.604，所有 q <= .007），且各具身条件之间差异不显著。经多重校正后，只有白鲸条件相对于对照组显著提升了即时的亲环境态度。在两个月后接受评估的287名回访者中（其间安排了一次按所分配条件进行的中间会话），白鲸条件在强化会话之前也显示出显著高于对照组的可持续产品选择（beta = .657，q = .0176）。尽管它并未……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究通过576人的随机实验发现，具身对话式AI化身能显著促进可持续消费选择，其中白鲸化身的效果尤为突出——不仅即时提升亲环境态度，其影响在两个月后的随访中依然持续存在。
en_tdlr: A randomized experiment (N = 576) shows that embodied conversational AI avatars significantly increase sustainable product choices, with a beluga whale avatar uniquely boosting pro-environmental attitudes both immediately and persistently two months later.
